notes: Static review only; no tools or simulation. Subtracting 8192 preserves ring addresses and unread distance; the later wr_count assignment includes simultaneous input. The exclusive branch leaves all rolling STF history intact and issues no scan. trigger/search_base are overwritten by the next detection; lts_start/window_start are overwritten at LOCK_LTS before use. Active packet positions remain untouched. Silent streams also rebase. Added scan delay is amortized one clock per 8192 samples, with bounded consecutive rebases after long packets; the 32-packet burst was not simulated.
